alt: 展示間裡幾張桌子放著一模一樣的老舊紙屋，工作人員又擺上同款模型，主辦者擺手拒絕志工帶來的斜坡庭院新設計。
scene_prompt: Inside a community exhibition storeroom, three old display tables in a row hold exactly the same faded cardboard house model with identical dull square windows and identical chipped roofs, visibly carried over from one exhibition to the next; dust and repaired edges show age. An organizer is setting out yet another identical copied model. A young volunteer offers a clearly different, thoughtful model with a curved accessible ramp and leafy courtyard, but the organizer turns away and points back to the old repeated models. Show habitual successive reuse and lack of invention. No dates, labels, writing, numerals or time arrows, no necessary safety rule context.
